summary.text: Kristi Pursell is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 58A, in office since 2023, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Republican Steven Cherney is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Kristi Pursell lives in Northfield, Minnesota, and earned a bachelor's degree in English language and literature and general and environmental studies from St. Olaf College in 2003 and a graduate certificate in environmental education from the University of Minnesota, Duluth, in 2006.

Her career experience includes working as a children's food educator at Midwest Food Connection, community engagement coordinator at the Cannon River Watershed Partnership, and executive director at Clean River Partners.
Kristi Pursell defeated Republican Rita Hillmann Olson in the November 5, 2024 general election.

Pursell's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy Committee (as Co-Vice Chair), the Health Finance and Policy Committee and the Rules and Legislative Administration Committee.
